descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Papertrail Inc. is throwing its costume party after hours: bunnies, clowns and cowboys dancing between the cubicles, cake on the buffet and a DJ at the standing desk. You walk in with a weapon in each hand. What happens next is up to you.

A WHOLE OFFICE BUILDING
The lobby, open-plan cubicles, copy room, break room, games lounge and CEO office; a boardroom, IT, HR, staff gym and party zone upstairs; a server room, archives and the IT crew's secret bunker below; plus the courtyard, parking and roof deck.

PULL THE FIRE ALARM
Shoot a red pull station: sirens, strobes, ceiling sprinklers raining on everyone - and every guest panics at once.

SHOOT EVERYTHING
Copiers that blow a storm of paper, vending machines that spill their cans, water coolers that fountain, monitors and server racks that spark, office chairs that roll, barrels that explode, pinatas and balloons everywhere.

A WEAPON WHEEL IN EACH HAND
Revolver, shotgun, rifle, sniper, bat, axe, hockey stick and knife. B opens the right-hand wheel, Y the left.

THE GUESTS FIGHT BACK
One loud noise wakes the floor. Brawlers charge, gunners fire slow rounds you can dodge, cowards hide until they come back angry. Heads, arms and legs come off. Clear a floor and a new crowd barges in.

Office models: "The Office Pack" (poly.pizza, CC-BY 3.0 / CC0) - every artist is credited in the game's lobby directory and on our website.
